assertions.subject: Brief psychotic disorder
assertions.quote: symptoms have remitted within one month of presentation

assertions.subject: Psychotic disorder, not otherwise specified
assertions.quote: Prior to symptomatic remission, a diagnosis of "psychotic disorder, not otherwise specified" may be given

assertions.subject: Psychotic affective disorder
assertions.quote: Psychotic affective disorder is diagnosed in the presence of a major mood component

assertions.subject: Psychotic affective disorder
assertions.quote: a patient with affective disorder with psychosis is not expected to return to baseline in 30 days, unlike patients with BPD

assertions.subject: Schizophrenia-spectrum disorders
assertions.quote: Schizophrenia-spectrum disorders such as schizophreniform disorder and schizophrenia are distinguished from BPD based mainly on the presence of symptoms for longer than 30 days

assertions.subject: Schizoaffective disorder
assertions.quote: psychotic symptoms consistent with schizophrenia concurrently with the mood symptoms and for at least 2 weeks in the absence of mood symptoms

assertions.subject: Personality disorder
assertions.quote: transient episodes of psychosis mostly induced by stress that may only last for 1 day or less

assertions.subject: Substance use disorder
assertions.quote: Substance intoxication, substance withdrawal, or medical conditions such as syphilis, neurosarcoidosis, metastasis likely secondary to lung cancer, thyrotoxicosis, and head trauma may occasionally present with symptoms that mimic that of BPD
